name: Augusta From Wuwa as Yasuo
creator: garyuu
description:
I really like Augusta from wuthering waves, so I tried to port her into yasuo, my main in lol.

I created 2 versions: one for the base skin with nightbringer yasuo VFX and another for the dragon truth yasuo skin, I like the second one better because I imported her echo from the game to it, and the effects match her better IMO

Both have the same Voice Pack

This is my first mod
